name: Back Room, Gypsy Trainer
desc1: This large, well-lit room is filled with hundreds of the oddest knick-
desc2: knacks you have ever seen, along with such things as bolts of silk and
desc3: coils of rope. A formidable man, wearing sunny, multi-coloured
desc4: clothes and glittering jewelry stands as you enter. He breaks into a
desc5: wide grin, saying "Welcome, stranger, my name is Cygani. How may I
desc6: help you?" You may exit through a doorway to the west.
